tools.name: verificar-anuncio
tools.description: Checks Portuguese ad/video copy against advertising rules: false promises, fake urgency, unproven numbers and comparisons, claims beyond declared benefits, missing affiliate disclosure. Deterministic. Price: $0.0090 per call (x402).

tools.name: margem
tools.description: Per-sale profit margin for e-commerce in Portugal: VAT, shipping, marketplace commission on gross price, fixed fee and returns. Exact decimal math. Price: $0.0045 per call (x402).

tools.name: detetor-ia-pt
tools.description: AI-generated text detector for European Portuguese (PT-PT): Binoculars method calibrated on Portuguese texts (AUROC 0.94, 1.7% false accusations). Returns a probability level, never proof. Text is not stored. Price: $0.0270 per call (x402).

tools.name: chat-gpt-oss
tools.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions from open-weight gpt-oss-120b (Apache-2.0), self-hosted in Portugal. Up to 1024 output tokens per call, ~50 tokens/s. Prompts and answers are not stored. Pay per request, only charged on success. Price: $0.002 per call (x402).

tools.name: localizar-pt-pt
tools.description: Rewrites Brazilian Portuguese text into European Portuguese (Portugal): vocabulary, gerund → 'a + infinitive', 'você'. Rule-based detection, local LLM rewrite, re-check of remaining BR markers. Returns unchanged text (free of LLM) when already PT-PT. Text not stored. Price: $0.01 per call (x402).

tools.description: Automated, passive Lighthouse audit of any public website or Shopify storefront (mobile emulation, single run): Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices and SEO scores, the failing audits and a 1-page PDF report (base64).
